text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Sistem

Insurans Pekerjaan (Perbekalan) 2025.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2026

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi tiga ratus enam puluh juta lima

ratus enam puluh satu ribu ringgit (RM360,561,000) daripada

Kumpulan Wang Insurans Pekerjaan bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran

Sistem Insurans Pekerjaan bagi tahun 2026 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud

yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

 Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 153,092,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 138,203,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 13,821,000

Perbelanjaan lain 21,555,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 33,890,000

JUMLAH 360,561,000

Dibuat 20 Disember 2025

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/28/9(7); PN(PU2)747/III]

DATO' SRI RAMANAN RAMAKRISHNAN

 Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM ACT 2017

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2025

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 48(1)

of the Employment Insurance System Act 2017 [Act 800], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employment Insurance System (Supply)

Regulations 2025.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2026

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding three hundred sixty million five hundred sixty

one thousand ringgit (RM360,561,000) from the Employment Insurance Fund for

the expenditure on administration of the Employment Insurance System

for the year 2026 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

 Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 153,092,000

Supplies and services 138,203,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 13,821,000

Other expenditures 21,555,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 33,890,000

TOTAL 360,561,000

Made 20 December 2025

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/28/9(7); PN(PU2)747/III]

DATO' SRI RAMANAN RAMAKRISHNAN

 Minister of Human Resources
